display_name: Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO (MIUI & HyperOS) — Clean Stock-Google Style

compatibility.summary: Hardware-tested ONLY on Redmi Note 10S (M2101K7BI, Android 13, MIUI Global 14.0.11.0.TKLINXM).
untested_notes: Xiaomi HyperOS, MIUI 12/13, China/EU/carrier ROMs, and models other than M2101K7BI are UNTESTED; always review the draft plan carefully.

notes: No OS change, no custom ROM, no root, no bootloader unlock. Uses official ADB --user 0 operations only.
Always inspect live device packages and run One-Click Backup + restore.py --dry-run before applying.
